newsitem.title: USA: HSN says Q2 results "on track".
newsitem.headline: HSN says Q2 results "on track".

text.p: HSN Inc Chairman Barry Diller said Tuesday the company's second quarter performance was "on track" but refused give specifics.

Diller spoke to reporters after addressing a Montgomery Securities conference here. Wall Street analysts estmate the company should earn $0.07 per share for the second quarter, up from $0.05 a year ago.
Diller declined to answer specific questions about the quarter's performance so far.
In his speech, Diller predicted revenues from "electronic commerce," including the Internet, would dwarf its current transaction and fulfillment business within the next five years.
HSN operates the Home Shopping Network.
